action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves at depth 4 to find the best continuation after Black's Bxg2.
action.rationale: Phase is broad_search, so candidate_moves must be empty and all legal root moves covered. Position: White is up a full rook (Ra8 vs knight) but Black's bishop on g2 attacks f1 and h1, and White has not castled. Need depth-4 search to identify safe, active moves that consolidate material without allowing Black counterplay, then verify the top candidate.
